import { getBackendSkillBookDecomposeQuery } from '@src/api/bot/skill-book-batch-decompose';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 一键分解功法指令处理器
 * 指令格式:
 *   /一键分解功法            → 展示选择提示与按钮
 *   /一键分解功法 全部        → 预览待分解内容，需确认
 *   /一键分解功法 <品级名>    → 预览待分解内容，需确认
 */
import { executeDecompose, fetchGradeOptions, previewDecompose } from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/batchDecompose/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import type { GuiButton } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse, useSubscribe } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [subscribe] = useSubscribe(selects);
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const rawText = String(e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
    const argPart = rawText.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?一键分解功法\s*/, '').trim();

    const query = await getBackendSkillBookDecomposeQuery(bid, uid, argPart);
    const optionsResult = await fetchGradeOptions({ bid, uid, prepared: query.options });

    if (optionsResult.code !== 'OK') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(optionsResult.data.message);

      if (optionsResult.code === 'EMPTY') {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText('💡 可分解的功法需满足：未锁定、未学习、未使用');
      }

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const { totalCount, grades: sortedGrades } = optionsResult.data;

    const gradeMap = new Map<string, { id: number; name: string }>();

    gradeMap.set('全部', { id: 0, name: '全部品级' });
    for (const g of sortedGrades) {
      gradeMap.set(g.name, { id: g.id, name: g.name });
    }

    // 无参数 → 展示按钮与提示
    if (!argPart) {
      const footerRows: GuiButton[][] = [];

      footerRows.push([{ label: `全部 (${totalCount}本)`, command: '/一键分解功法 全部' }]);
      for (let i = 0; i < sortedGrades.length; i += 3) {
        const slice = sortedGrades.slice(i, i + 3);

        footerRows.push(slice.map(g => ({ label: `${g.name} (${g.count}本)`, command: `/一键分解功法 ${g.name}` })));
      }

      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addBold('一键分解功法');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('选择分解范围，每次最多分解300本。');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡 已锁定、已学习、使用中的功法不会被分解');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: footerRows }));

      return;
    }

    const selectedGrade = gradeMap.get(argPart);

    if (!selectedGrade) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`❌ 无效的品级：${argPart}`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('请发送：/一键分解功法 查看可选项。');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const gradeId = selectedGrade.id === 0 ? undefined : selectedGrade.id;

    // ===== 二次确认：先预览 =====
    if (!query.preview) {
      throw new Error('一键分解预览接口响应不完整');
    }
    const previewResult = await previewDecompose({ bid, uid, gradeId, prepared: query.preview });

    if (previewResult.code !== 'OK') {
      const failMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      failMd.addText('❌ 预览失败');
      failMd.addNewline();
      failMd.addNewline();
      failMd.addText(previewResult.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: failMd, footer: [{ label: '/一键分解功法', command: '/一键分解功法' }] }));

      return;
    }

    const previewMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    previewMd.addBold('⚠️ 分解确认');
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`分解范围：${selectedGrade.name}`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`待分解总数：${previewResult.data.totalCount} 本`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`本次分解：${previewResult.data.processCount} 本；剩余：${previewResult.data.remainingCount} 本`);
    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addBold('范围内品级分布：');
    previewMd.addNewline();

    for (const gb of previewResult.data.gradeBreakdown) {
      previewMd.addText(`• ${gb.gradeName} ×${gb.count}`);
      previewMd.addNewline();
    }

    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText(`预估总经验：${previewResult.data.totalExp}`);
    previewMd.addNewline();

    if (previewResult.data.estimatedItems.length > 0) {
      previewMd.addNewline();
      previewMd.addBold('预估获得：');
      previewMd.addNewline();
      for (const ei of previewResult.data.estimatedItems) {
        previewMd.addText(`• ${ei.name} x${ei.amount}`);
        previewMd.addNewline();
      }
    }

    previewMd.addNewline();
    previewMd.addText('请在60秒内回复【确认分解】或【取消】');

    const confirmFooter: GuiButton[] = [
      { label: '确认分解', command: '确认分解' },
      { label: '取消', command: '取消' }
    ];

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: previewMd, footer: [confirmFooter] }));

    // 进入订阅等待确认
    const sub = subscribe.mount(
      async (event, next) => {
        const [msg] = useMessage();
        const choice = event.MessageText.trim();

        if (choice === '确认分解') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);

          const result = await executeDecompose({ bid, uid, gradeId, request: createBackendRequestContext(event) });

          if (result.code !== 'OK') {
            const failMd = Format.createMarkdown();

            failMd.addText('❌ 分解失败');
            failMd.addNewline();
            failMd.addNewline();
            failMd.addText(result.data.message);

            void msg.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: failMd, footer: [{ label: '/一键分解功法', command: '/一键分解功法' }] }));

            return;
          }

          const okMd = Format.createMarkdown();

          okMd.addBold('✅ 分解成功');
          okMd.addNewline();
          okMd.addText(`分解范围：${selectedGrade.name}`);
          if (result.data.remainingCount > 0) {
            okMd.addNewline().addText(`数量过多，本次已分解${result.data.decomposedCount}本，剩余${result.data.remainingCount}本可分解。`);
          }
          okMd.addNewline();
          okMd.addText(`分解数量：${result.data.decomposedCount} 本`);
          okMd.addNewline();
          okMd.addText(`总计折算经验：${result.data.totalExp}`);
          okMd.addNewline();

          if (result.data.items.length > 0) {
            okMd.addText('获得功法残页：');
            okMd.addNewline();

            for (const item of result.data.items) {
              okMd.addText(`• ${item.name} x${item.amount}`);
              okMd.addNewline();
            }
          }

          const okFooter = [
            { label: '继续分解', command: `/一键分解功法 ${argPart}` },
            { label: '查看储物袋', command: '/储物袋 功法' }
          ];

          void msg.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: okMd, footer: okFooter }));

          return;
        }

        if (choice === '取消') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          const cancelMd = Format.createMarkdown();

          cancelMd.addText('已取消分解操作');
          cancelMd.addNewline();
          cancelMd.addText('💡 可以先锁定不想分解的功法，再使用一键分解');

          void msg.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: cancelMd, footer: [{ label: '/一键分解功法', command: '/一键分解功法' }] }));

          return;
        }

        const hintMd = Format.createMarkdown();
        const hintFooter = [
          { label: '确认分解', command: '确认分解' },
          { label: '取消', command: '取消' }
        ];

        hintMd.addText('请回复【确认分解】或【取消】');

        void msg.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: hintMd, footer: [hintFooter] }));

        next();
      },
      ['UserId']
    );

    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        subscribe.cancel(sub);
        const timeoutMd = Format.createMarkdown();

        timeoutMd.addText('⏰ 确认超时，分解操作已自动取消');

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: timeoutMd, footer: [{ label: '/一键分解功法', command: '/一键分解功法' }] }));
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
    }, 60 * 1000);
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('一键分解功法失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
